title: Atlassian Rovo Exfiltrates Data, Bypassing Controls
summary: A security research article exposing a critical vulnerability in Atlassian Rovo where the AI-powered enterprise search tool can exfiltrate sensitive data by bypassing access controls, potentially exposing confidential corporate information to unauthorized users.
problem_solved: Documents a serious data exfiltration vulnerability in Atlassian's AI product that bypasses permission controls, allowing unauthorized access to sensitive corporate data.
why_valuable: This security disclosure is critical for enterprise security teams using Atlassian products, as it reveals a fundamental flaw in how AI-powered search tools handle access controls, with implications for the broader AI enterprise security landscape.
